title: Block C++: Noughts and Crosses (Visual Studio 2022 edition)
description: An inclusive C++ course in a Visual Studio 2022 style workspace. Learners create a Console App project, explore Solution Explorer, then build a Noughts and Crosses game line by line using shaped blocks or real C++ code. Both views stay in sync: typed code is turned back into blocks. Programs run in a built-in simulator, or on a real compiler online.
subject: Computer Science
topics: Libraries: cmath, cstdlib, ctime, iomanip, algorithm, cctype
audience: Learners new to text-based programming, including learners with dyslexia and learning difficulties
learningOutcomes: Use #include and namespaces to set up a C++ program
Declare variables and 2D arrays with suitable data types
Write and call void and value-returning functions
Use for loops, nested for loops and while loops
Make decisions with if, else and else if
Read input with cin and print output with cout
Group data with a struct and model objects with classes and inheritance
Run, test and export a complete C++ program
features: Simulated Visual Studio 2022 project wizard, menus, Solution Explorer, Toolbox, Error List, Output and Debug Console
Blocks and code tabs for the same file, kept in sync both ways
Editable C++ code with syntax colouring, squiggles and Visual Studio style error codes
Shape-checked blocks with live validation and plain-English errors
Line-by-line guide with auto-ticking checklists for every step
JavaScript simulator that runs the learner's own program
Optional real build and run through Compiler Explorer (GCC or Clang)
Copy or download the .cpp file, undo, keyboard shortcuts and tap-to-place
